crossRunOverlap: The controls none records are canonically identical to suite none records at the thirty shared task/seed cells. Separate run directories do not establish fresh independent baseline execution; never pool their denominators.
episodePopulation: Every published task/seed/arm record of each run; runs remain separate. Not-applicable records remain visible and outside measured denominators.

erratum.interpretation: The no-target and scrambled controls undermine targeted-control/semantic-reframing attribution. Counts stay unchanged; scope is envelope fragility under long imperative out-of-distribution instructions.

estimands: equal-task mean of per-task applicable publisher flags
matching: Within a run, every arm shares task and seed with none; reported policy seed, checkpoint, horizon and original instruction are checked. Unrecorded runtime conditions remain unknown.
outcome: Publisher reported success is an envelope-exit flag, not clean task success or targeted object control. The reader checks native decision flags for consistency, without evaluating actions or the safety predicate.
provenance: Keep every native execution manifest literal. Null repository, dependency lock, precision, checkpoint digest and schema/config digests stay null. Preserve suite runtime commit null and controls short commit de6c231 without resolving or extending it.

holmFamilies.control: All five non-baseline arms, including four harmless-variation controls; this is broader than the README phrasing.

publisherIntervals.method: task bootstrap random.Random(0), 2000 iterations, endpoint index floor(p*(N-1)); None for collapsed endpoints
publisherIntervals.relation: Retained as publisher analysis, distinct from this exact joint paired count distribution. Neither interval is certified coverage.
publisherIntervals.source: aggregate.json and src/provael/scoring/paired.py at the publication pin

residualDependence: Tasks share policy, simulator and benchmark. Whole-task resampling keeps within-task repeats and all arms paired but does not remove dependence between tasks.
taskPopulation: The ten published LIBERO-Object tasks; selected benchmark tasks, with shared policy and simulator. No random sample of an external task population is established.

uncertainty.assumption: Interpreting these nominal bounds beyond retained tasks requires independent exchangeable tasks from a stated population; the source does not establish this.
uncertainty.degenerate: retain the point distribution and mark degenerate; no population interval or absence claim follows
uncertainty.method: exact paired whole-task empirical percentile bootstrap via integer-weight joint count convolution
uncertainty.quantile: inverse empirical CDF: smallest value whose cumulative integer weight reaches ceil(p * totalWeight)
uncertainty.samplingUnit: one task containing every native arm and seed
uncertainty.unsupportedAllocation: refuse empty/partially applicable arms, unequal task denominators or incomplete matching rather than silently exclude tasks
